text: **dsh-maestro-mobile**（DSH Web 插件，网页客户端）：为手机和平板上的 DSH Web 界面提供触屏适配。它在客户端注册样式和界面插槽，并在主机侧提供会话删除路由与按需响应压缩。主要功能包括把侧栏改为可滑动抽屉、将设置等对话框改为适配安全区域的底部面板、调整输入栏与软键盘交互，以及从会话菜单删除会话。适合用触屏设备访问 DSH Web 的用户；需要运行 DSH Web，且适配限于窄屏触屏场景。

**dsh-maestro-mobile** is a DSH Web client plugin for touch phones and tablets. It adds a mobile sidebar drawer, safe-area-aware dialog sheets, composer keyboard adjustments, and session deletion from the session menu. It is intended for narrow touch screens running DSH Web.
想在手机上更方便地使用 DSH Web。
能把 DSH 的侧边栏改成手机抽屉吗？
平板上设置窗口太挤了，想改成底部面板。
手机点输入栏工具按钮时，不想总弹出软键盘。
希望从会话菜单直接删除不需要的会话。
触屏窄屏下想让 DSH 对话区域更适合阅读和操作。
Can I use DSH Web more comfortably on a phone?
I want the sidebar to work as a touch friendly drawer.
DSH Maestro Mobile 的「手机侧栏抽屉」功能：在窄屏触屏设备上将侧栏作为覆盖式抽屉显示，并提供开关和遮罩交互；通过触摸侧栏按钮或滑动进行导航。
DSH Maestro Mobile 的「移动端会话删除」功能：在触屏设备的会话行菜单中加入删除操作，用户选择后经过确认并调用主机删除路由，随后刷新会话列表。
DSH Maestro Mobile 的「软键盘触控适配」功能：监听触屏活动并处理输入栏工具按钮的触控鼠标事件，避免普通工具栏点击意外聚焦编辑器并弹出软键盘。
DSH Maestro Mobile 的「安全区域与面板布局」功能：客户端样式为移动端侧栏及设置面板使用安全区域间距和窄屏布局，让刘海屏或小屏设备上的界面内容保持可见。

@ddtcorex/dsh-maestro-mobile README · dsh-maestro-mobile：Mobile adaptation for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI. On touch-primary devices below 1024px it turns the sidebar into an overlay drawer, sheets the dialogs, and tunes the composer for phones; any mouse-driven window, at every width, is a complete no-op — a narrow desktop window or a scaled display never gets the mobile shell.

@ddtcorex/dsh-maestro-mobile README · What you get：| Capability | How it works |
|---|---|
| Sidebar → drawer | On touch-primary devices below 1024px the sidebar becomes a left overlay drawer (~80vw, `transform:none` when open); desktop is untouched at every width |
| Dialogs → sheets | Settings, explorer, and preview become mobile-friendly bottom sheets with `env(safe-area-inset-*)` handling and notch avoidance |
| Status-bar & safe areas | Status-bar / notch padding, light/dark `theme-color`, and `touch-action: manipulation` + `gesturestart` guard against double-tap zoom |
| Composer stays clean | Permission capsule, model name, and switch menus use fixed-size pinning so they never squeeze or overlap on narrow screens |
| Tablet friendly | 768–1023px centered, width-constrained sheets; phone and tablet geometries are verified separately |
| Easy diagnostics | Append `?dsh-maestro-mobile-debug=1` for a floating bar with viewport / frame / floating-panel / JS-error state |

@ddtcorex/dsh-maestro-mobile README · Requirements：Response compression is the host's job when it is enabled: with `webServer`
configured `compression: gzip` (the deployed profile does this) the plugin leaves
the responses alone, because DSH's own middleware already serves brotli/gzip and
wins the `writeHead` race. On a profile that keeps the host default
(`compression: none`) the plugin installs its own transparent gzip/brotli patch.

@ddtcorex/dsh-maestro-mobile README · Architecture：- Host / client split is load-bearing: `src/index.ts` owns the session-delete route (`POST /api/mobile-nav.session.delete`) plus the conditional response-compression patch; all browser behavior lives in `src/client/`.
- The delete route authenticates through the host (`connection.requestRejection`) because the `/api` launch-token fence is a prefix route that an exact route shadows; it fails closed with `503 admission-unavailable` when the host publishes no connection service.
- `src/client/index.tsx` injects `['slots','layout','locale','sessionLogDownload','sessions','workspaces']`, registers locale dictionaries, injects one `<style data-plugin>` tag, and registers three slots (`MobileNavToggle` in the session header, `MobileDrawerFooter` in the sidebar foot, `ShellOverlay` backdrop + FAB).
- Shared full-tree reconciler: `src/client/core/reconciler-core.ts` (zero-import engine) + `phone-chrome.ts` (a single `MutationObserver` driving `installMobileEffect`).
